page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg6.16xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the Intel Xeon 8269CY processor. Running on the KVM hypervisor, this instance features 64 dedicated physical cores with a 1.0 thread-per-core configuration, providing 64 vCPUs with no hyperthreading. The processor operates at a baseline clock speed of 3.1 GHz. It is equipped with 256.0 GB of system memory, yielding a balanced memory-to-core ratio of 4.0 GB per core.

This instance does not include any local NVMe or SSD storage, requiring external block storage volumes for operating system and application data. It also lacks dedicated GPU hardware accelerators, making it unsuitable for hardware-accelerated machine learning or graphics rendering workloads. For network connectivity, the instance provides a baseline network bandwidth of 20 Gbps. It does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated core allocation ensures predictable compute performance without resource contention, representing a high-density compute profile within the general-purpose class. The lack of bundled local storage and GPU hardware reduces baseline infrastructure costs for workloads that rely on network-attached storage. This configuration is suitable for multi-threaded enterprise applications, web serving, database hosting, and general-purpose workloads that require consistent CPU performance without hyperthreading overhead.
